description: Modify the ratatui crate to allow ratatui-widgets to be included without default features, and make the `time` crate dependency conditional on the `std` feature. This will reduce the dependency tree for users who don't need certain functionality.
functional_requirements: Update the main Cargo.toml to make ratatui-widgets an optional dependency that can be included without its default features
Modify ratatui-widgets' Cargo.toml to make the `time` crate dependency conditional on the `std` feature being enabled
Ensure the crate still compiles correctly with all feature combinations (with/without widgets, with/without std)
Update any feature documentation to reflect the new optional nature of ratatui-widgets
